name: Lira Main Market
description: The city's main market sells fresh produce, grains, textiles, and handmade crafts.

name: Lira University Campus
description: Lira University offers programs in higher education, health, and applied research in Northern Uganda.

name: Akii-Bua Olympic Stadium
description: The stadium is named after John Akii-Bua, Uganda's first Olympic gold medalist. It hosts sports and community events.

name: Barlonyo Memorial Site
description: This memorial honors people affected by past violence and teaches visitors about peace and community resilience.

name: Lira Golf Course & Club
description: The golf course provides outdoor recreation, club activities, and space for community gatherings.

name: Lango Cultural Foundation Palace
description: The palace represents Lango traditions, music, local leadership, and the preservation of cultural history.

name: Nile Breeze Botanical Gardens
description: The gardens have open green spaces where families can walk, gather, and attend outdoor events.

name: Lira Industrial & Agro-Processing Park
description: The park is home to businesses that process sunflower oil, shea butter, and other regional products.
